data.name: M_WitnessModeNotice
data.value: Ordinary mode draws locally immediately, works offline, and saves a locally replayable proof. When online, new proofs are submitted for server replay verification in the background. Offline historical proofs are not uploaded automatically; you can upload them manually on the verification website. The signature binds the proof content and can detect later file changes, but does not prove that the local program or roster was unchanged before the draw.

data.name: M_ModeConfirmLocal
data.value:
Ordinary mode draws locally immediately, works offline, and saves a replayable proof. When online, the app submits one replay-signing request in the background to fair.sectl.cn only for each newly completed ordinary draw; offline or failed historical proofs are not uploaded automatically. It can prove that the submitted proof can be replayed and detect changes after signing.
It cannot prove that the local program, real roster, or random seed was unchanged before the draw, nor rule out repeated trials and selection before the draw.

data.name: M_ModeConfirmFormal
data.value:
Formal notarization first locks this anonymous candidate pool, weights, and rules at fair.sectl.cn; the server then generates random material, calculates the final result, and saves an immutable official proof.
If network instability, disconnection, service unavailability, device failure, or force majeure prevents a completed server proof, no local substitute is generated and ordinary mode is not used automatically. After the server confirms the lock, the candidate pool, weights, rules, random material, and result cannot be replaced, supplemented, or recalculated in the same flow. A new draw is a separate notarization.
This prevents replacement of local draw code, random seeds, or result files during the locked flow, but cannot prove that the real roster is complete and authentic or that the pool was not manually filtered before submission.

data.name: S_LocalProofRetention_D
